about_short_description.short_description: Optifye.ai is an AI-based optimization platform that monitors assembly lines and automated reporting services.

product.name: Real-time Quality Checking
product.description: Monitors assembly line operations to verify adherence to correct assembly steps in real time.

product.name: Precise Workspace Output Measurement
product.description: Automates counting of workspace and line-specific production output to provide accurate production data.

product.name: Automated Reporting Service
product.description: Delivers daily production and performance reports via WhatsApp and email to management and supervisors.

product.name: Cycle Time Analysis
product.description: Measures production cycle times at each workstation to identify delays and optimize workflow.

product.name: Bottleneck Detection
product.description: Identifies bottlenecks in the assembly line to help balance workloads and improve flow.

product.name: Axel Continuous Improvement Agent
product.description: Analyzes production and ERP data to provide continuous improvement insights and real-time recommendations.
